@zakkster/lite-cleanup v1.0.0

Zero-GC FinalizationRegistry helper for the @zakkster/lite-* ecosystem.
Extracted from the shared pattern used by lite-observe and lite-floating.

PUBLIC API
----------
VERSION: string

createDisposalRegistry(options?) -> registry
  options.name?: string                          // diagnostics label
  options.onCollect?: (tag) => void              // FR path only
  options.onError?: (err, tag) => void           // cleanup throw routing

registry.register(target, cleanup, tag?) -> handle
registry.unregister(handle) -> void              // idempotent; issuing-registry only
registry.size() -> number
registry.name: string

SEMANTICS
---------
- Explicit unregister CANCELS the finalizer; does NOT run cleanup.
- HANDLE PROVENANCE (1.1.0): a registry only acts on handles it issued
  (WeakSet of records). A foreign object, another registry's handle, a
  primitive or null is a NO-OP: never counted, never mutated, never throws.
  size() therefore fails closed and can never go negative -- consumers gate on
  size() === 0 meaning "nothing pending".
- record.disposed is ADVISORY. Ownership/liveness live in the WeakSet, so a
  caller writing handle.disposed = true cannot defeat unregister(). Writes to
  the record are guarded: a frozen/sealed/hostile-setter handle must not throw
  from unregister() or, worse, from inside the finalizer.
- register() VALIDATES (1.1.0): target must be object | function | symbol
  (unregistered symbols are legal FR targets since ES2023); tag must not be
  === target (the record is the FR held value and would pin it forever; deeper
  reachability is undetectable and stays caller discipline); cleanup must be
  callable, null, or undefined. cleanup null/undefined = "observe only,
  nothing to run" -- lite-leak's track(target, null, tag) relies on it.
  Caller is responsible for running cleanup manually if needed.
- FR path (target GC'd without unregister): runs cleanup, then onCollect(tag).
- onCollect fires on FR path only. Use as a leak signal.
- Errors in cleanup route to onError; if onError itself throws, swallowed.
- Race safe: unregister after FR enqueue does not double-fire.

HELD-VALUE CONTRACT (LOAD-BEARING)
----------------------------------
The `cleanup` closure MUST NOT close over `target`. Capturing the target
keeps it reachable via the FR itself and defeats finalization. This is
caller discipline; un-enforceable at runtime.

Wrong: registry.register(target, () => target.dispose())
Right: const r = target.resource; registry.register(target, () => r.release())

ZERO-GC PROFILE
---------------
register()   1 alloc (~24 B record); not hot-path
unregister() 0 B/call, 0 scavenges; hot-path
FR callback  0 B/call, 0 scavenges
size()       0 B/call

REQUIREMENTS
------------
- Node 20+ or browsers with FinalizationRegistry
- No runtime dependencies
- Single-file ESM, ASCII-only

WHY
---
Two libraries (lite-observe, lite-floating) inlined the same FR bookkeeping.
lite-leak needs it with additional hooks. This package is the canonical
primitive both consume.

NON-GOALS
---------
- Not a garbage collector (FR timing is non-deterministic)
- Not a WeakRef helper
- Not a resource pool
